The Milton draft also had what Milton serves after setup: its instructions, its two tools, and one get_report result holding the person's five pasted emails as examples. There was no cover sheet and no changes from first drafts, because these people have only pasted emails and have not yet accepted a draft from an AI. Fictional people. Edited for display: the bold markers around the subject line are removed, and two or three spaced em dashes were added by hand to each plain draft in place of punctuation, for effect. Apart from the bold markers, the Milton drafts are as generated, each on its first try. Bill's fictional employer is renamed Odderton Data Services wherever the run named it. The subject of Peter's plain "Ask for something" is shortened.
